release_notes: Build 78 moves Comment moderation out of Settings and into the main app sidebar directly after Website and Users.
The existing Reported, Visible, Hidden and All queues, search, Hide, Restore, Dismiss reports, Delete and Open quiz actions are unchanged.
Build 77 adds a dedicated Comment moderation page to the desktop app Settings, with Reported, Visible, Hidden and All queues plus search across comments, users and quizzes.

Website administrators can hide, restore, dismiss reports, safely delete comments and open the affected quiz directly from the app; the secured tracker admin API uses the website's existing comment/report data.
Build 76 keeps the visible Autopilot Needs You cards synchronized with the aligned task list even if an older home refresh temporarily writes stale counts.

If the home panel shows a stale Related Video count such as 14 while Needs You is 9, the sync now detects the rendered title mismatch and repairs it without returning to the one-second button flashing fixed in Build 75.
Build 75 stops the Autopilot Needs You panel from rebuilding its buttons every second when the task counts have not changed.

The Needs You counter still refreshes every second, but the task cards are only reconstructed when the actual Related Video, Instagram, reply, rescue or warning breakdown changes, eliminating the flashing Manage task queue button.
Build 74 makes the Autopilot Needs You total and grouped home task cards use the same aligned task list, so completed Related Video items no longer inflate the Shorts count.
Related Video, Instagram, viewer reply, packaging rescue and release warning card counts now add up to the Needs You total from one source of truth.
Build 73 makes the Autopilot home Instagram card use the same due-time rule as Needs You, so future and waiting promos are no longer shown as work requiring attention.
The home Instagram card now appears only for Next day promos whose posting time has arrived, and its count reflects only promos that can actually be published now.
Build 72 keeps future and waiting Instagram promos out of Needs You until their Instagram posting time has actually arrived.
The Needs You counter, Instagram task list and publishing workflow now use the same due-time rule, so unavailable promos no longer inflate work requiring attention.
Build 71 excludes comments authored by mark36ph from Full Autopilot viewer-reply approval work, including @mark36ph and case variations.
Existing saved reply drafts for the channel owner's own posts are removed from Autopilot state, so they no longer appear in Viewer reply tasks or inflate the Needs You count.
Build 70 moves Maintenance Mode out of Website Users and into a dedicated Website settings page, with the on/off control and visitor message together.

Maintenance Mode now has a browser-side full-page fallback so normal visitors see only the maintenance notice even when a cached/static page is loaded; administrators keep full site access with the maintenance banner.
Reported quiz questions now appear in Website settings with the quiz, question, reason, reporter and status, plus Resolve, Dismiss and Reopen actions.
Build 69 lets website administrators create player accounts directly from the desktop Users page, including usernames that are reserved from public signup such as Admin, Support and Factburst.
Admin-created accounts use a short-lived one-use provisioning token and the website's normal PBKDF2 password hashing path, so the reserved-name bypass is never exposed to ordinary visitors.
Administrators can activate an existing unverified website profile without the user clicking the verification email; activation also restores the account to active status if it was suspended.
Build 68 adds Factburst user groups (User, Moderator and Admin), role controls in the desktop Users page, an explicit View friends popup and website maintenance controls.
Verified users can change email safely: the existing verified address remains active until the replacement address is confirmed.
Quiz profiles include Daily Quiz streaks, XP and levels, achievements, category progress, saved and recent quizzes, recommendations and richer player statistics.
Friends include weekly/monthly/all-time competition views, challenge result/rematch support and live head-to-head quiz matches.
The site includes notifications, weekly tournaments, quiz reactions, result-card sharing, question reporting and personalised homepage content.
Quiz comments include replies, likes, editing, reporting and moderator/admin management controls.
